design.order: after L6's merge (last step of maybe_apply_final_id_fill). Why: neighbours and LLM candidates are the merged states (two 'ER state' rows are one place); a placeholder L6 already merged into a stated state is not estimated twice. Cost: two reactions that become exact duplicates only once L7 places them are not merged by L6 (2 pairs on the replays: idx 6, 113).
design.unstated: empty biological_state, or a reference to a placeholder (__auto_state__, AutoState_*); an unresolvable name is left alone
design.step1_neighbours: BFS over reactions sharing a participant, excluding cofactor_policy.VOCABULARY (currency + hubs) and every transport cargo (a transported compound sits on both sides of a membrane: idx 84 would otherwise put enterobactin biosynthesis extracellular); traverses unstated reactions, stops at stated ones; exactly one informative state -> neighbour_estimate. A eukaryote 'cell'/'intracellular' state names no compartment and never decides (idx 134 'human carnitine biosynthesis'). Estimates never feed other estimates.
design.step2_llm: one call per payload, temperature 0, JSON, chat_detailed with OPENROUTER_EXTRACTION_MODEL, timeout 120 s, max_tokens 4000; input = organism, candidate states, items (reaction equation/enzymes/evidence/text around evidence, linked states; transport cargo/known side/asked sides), paper text head (60,000 chars) or the evidence sentences. Accepted only with a verbatim >=3-word quote and a candidate state, or a new location named in the quote that map_vocabulary_name resolves (exact/mapped). Transport sides must differ. Cached in the fill cache (key: prompt id + sha256 of system+user). Skipped: T2PW_FINAL_PAYLOAD_BUDGET_S=0 (cached reply still used), T2PW_OFFLINE_CURATOR with no injected chat_fn, open fetch circuit, job deadline within margin.
design.step3_general_state: DEFERRED (GENERAL_STATE_FALLBACK = False). When on: reactions only: an existing state of the pathway organism with location cytoplasm (prokaryote)/cell (eukaryote), no cell type/tissue and a name saying nothing else; else the pipeline's __auto_state__ renamed '<its species> <its location>' with every reference re-pointed (L6's _iter_state_refs); else a new '<organism> cytoplasm|cell' state (+ location entity row). review_required + review_reasons 'compartment_not_stated: ...'. Organism = the run's likely_organism when the payload carries it (idx 135: Saposhnikovia, not the Arabidopsis expression host), else the states' majority species, else the normalizer's default species.
design.transports: per missing side: neighbours only when the other side is stated (cargo's other reactions minus that state, one state); LLM for the rest (both sides must differ). Deviation from the brief, by evidence: step 3 is NOT applied to a transport side (round 1 turned idx 3 'apical side -> Type III cell', right by accident, into 'cell -> Type III cell'); an unestimated side keeps what it had and the row is flagged. No direction invented. Element-level sides untouched.
design.vocabulary: compartment_source: neighbour_estimate | llm_estimate | unresolved (L7); 'estimated' kept as written by L6 (placeholder merged into a stated state); absent = stated. Each change appends a compartment_estimate entry {step, field, from_state, to_state, source, reason, evidence...}. Payload record: final_payload_compartments (only when something changed).
